notes.peak_time: seconds from file start of the moment to align with the visual hit (sample peak for one-shots, 30 ms RMS maximum for preroll sounds, null for loops)
notes.onset_time: first moment the signal exceeds -40 dB re its peak (one-shots start within 5 ms)
notes.gain_hint_db: natural level of this variation relative to its family (all one-shots are peak-normalised to -3 dBFS; apply this to keep natural variation)
notes.mix_hint_db: suggested starting playback gain under a voice-over mix
notes.loops: exactly periodic buffers: play with sample-accurate looping
